entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ came one day with joy visible on his face and said: "Gabriel came to me and said: 'Does it not please you, O Muhammad, that no one from your community invokes blessings upon you except that I invoke blessings upon him ten times, and no one greets you with peace except that I greet him with peace ten times?'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَني جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ زَاذَانَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلَامَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Sa'ib, from Zadhan, from Ibn Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "God has angels who roam the earth and convey to me the greetings of peace from my community."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ سَوَادَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلًا حَدَّثَهُ ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ حَدَّثَهُ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى صَلَاةً غَيْرَ سَاهٍ وَلَا لَاهٍ ، كَفَّرَ عَنْهُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَهَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather informed us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a; Bakr b. Sawada narrated to me that a man narrated to him, from Rabi'a b. Qays, that he heard 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhani say:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "Whoever makes ablution and does it well, then prays a prayer neither heedless nor distracted, it expiates for him whatever came before it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ أَبِي أَنَسٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَافِعِ بْنِ الْعَمْيَاءِ ، وَعَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الصَّلَاةُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى تَشَهُّدٌ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ، وَتَخَشُّعٌ وَتَضَرُّعٌ وَتَمَسْكُنٌ ، ثُمَّ تُقْنِعُ يَدَيْكَ ، يَقُولُ: تَرْفَعُهُمَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقْبِلًا بِبُطُونِهِمَا وَجْهَكَ ، تَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ ، يَا رَبِّ ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فَهِيَ خِدَاجٌ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Layth b. Sa'd; 'Abd Rabbih b. Sa'id narrated to me, from 'Imran b. Abi Anas, from 'Abd Allah b. Nafi' b. al-'Amya', and from Rabi'a b. al-Harith, from al-Fadl b. 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The prayer is two (units) by two (units), with a tashahhud after every two units, with humility, supplication, and lowliness. Then you stretch out your hands," meaning, "you raise them to your Lord, with the palms facing your face, and say: 'O my Lord, O my Lord.' Whoever does not do so, his prayer is deficient."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّ الرَّحْمَةَ تُوَاجِهُهُ، فَلَا يُحَرِّكَنَّ الْحَصَى»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ma'mar, that he heard al-Zuhri relate, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abu Dharr, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When one of you stands for prayer, mercy faces him, so let him not move the pebbles."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْأَحْوَصِ مَوْلَى بَنِي كَثِيرٍ ، يُحَدِّثُنَا فِي مَجْلِسِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، وَابْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ جَالِسٌ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا ذَرٍّ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَزَالُ اللَّهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَى الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَلتَفِتْ ، فَإِذَا صَرَفَ وَجْهَهُ انْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu al-Ahwas, the freedman of the Banu Kathir, relate to us in the assembly of Ibn al-Musayyab (Ibn al-Musayyab was sitting there), that he heard Abu Dharr say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "God continues to turn toward the servant so long as he does not turn aside; when he turns his face away, He turns away from him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مَمْلَكٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ قِرَاءَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَاتِهِ ، فَقَالَتْ: «مَا لَكُمْ وَصَلَاتَهُ؟ كَانَ يُصَلِّي ، ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَدْرَ مَا يُصَلِّي ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي قَدْرَ مَا نَامَ ، ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَدْرَ مَا يُصَلِّي ، حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ ، وَنَعَتَتْ لَهُ قِرَاءَتَهُ ، فَإِذَا هِيَ تَنْعَتُ قِرَاءَتَهُ مُفَسَّرَةً حَرْفًا حَرْفًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Layth b. Sa'd, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, who narrated to him from Ya'la b. Mamlak, that he asked Umm Salama about the recitation of the Prophet ﷺ and his prayer. She said:
entries.matn_en: "What have you to do with his prayer? He would pray, then sleep for as long as he had prayed, then pray for as long as he had slept, then sleep for as long as he had prayed, until morning." And she described his recitation, and she was describing his recitation as clearly distinguished, letter by letter.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ نُعَيْمٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ مِخْرَاقٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ: يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ، إِنَّ نَاسًا يَقرأُ أَحَدُهُمُ الْقُرْآنَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا؟ فَقَالَتْ: «أُولَئِكَ قَرَءُوا وَلَمْ يَقْرَءُوا ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُومُ اللَّيْلَةَ التَّمَامَ فِيَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَسُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ ، وَسُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ ، لَا يَمُرُّ بِآيَةٍ فِيهَا اسْتِبْشَارٌ إِلَّا دَعَا وَرَغَّبَ ، وَلَا يَمُرُّ بِآيَةٍ فِيهَا تَخْوِيفٌ إِلَّا دَعَا اللَّهَ وَاسْتَعَاذَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah b. al-Mubarak informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a, from al-Harith b. Yazid, from Ziyad b. Nu'aym al-Hadrami, from Muslim b. Mikhraq, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to 'A'isha: "O Mother of the Believers, some people recite the Qur'an twice or three times in a night." She said: "Those people recited and did not recite. The Messenger of God ﷺ would stand the whole night and recite Surat al-Baqara, Surat Al 'Imran, and Surat al-Nisa'; he would never pass a verse containing glad tidings without supplicating and expressing longing, and he would never pass a verse containing a warning without supplicating to God and seeking refuge."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا حَسَدَ إِلَّا عَلَى اثْنَتَيْنِ: رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ فَهُوَ يَقُومُ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim b. 'Abd Allah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "There is no envy (permissible) except concerning two: a man to whom God has given wealth and he spends from it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day; and a man to whom God has given this Qur'an and he stands (in prayer) with it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا حَسَدَ إِلَّا فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ: رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالًا فَسَلَّطَهُ عَلَى هَلَكَتِهِ فِي حَقٍّ ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ حِكْمَةً فَهُوَ يَقْضِي بِهَا وَيُعَلِّمُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "There is no envy (permissible) except concerning two: a man to whom God has given wealth and empowered him to spend it away in the cause of truth; and a man to whom God has given wisdom, so he judges by it and teaches it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، أَخْبَرَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، أَنَّ شُرَيْحًا الْحَضْرَمِيَّ ، ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ: «ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ لَا يَتَوَسَّدُ الْقُرْآنَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri: al-Sa'ib b. Yazid informed me that Shurayh al-Hadrami was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he said:
entries.matn_en: "That is a man who does not use the Qur'an as a pillow (i.e., neglect it)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مِنَ اللَّيْلِ سَاعَةٌ لَا يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا إِلَّا أُعْطِيَهُ ، وَهِيَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "In the night there is an hour that no Muslim servant happens upon while asking God for good except that he is given it, and it is every night."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَوْفٍ ، عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ أَبِي مَخْلَدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مُسْلِمٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ: أَيُّ قِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي ، فَقَالَ: «نِصْفُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ جَوْفُ اللَّيْلِ» ، شَكَّ عَوْفٌ، وَقَلِيلٌ فَاعِلُهُ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Awf, from al-Muhajir Abu Makhlad, from Abu al-'Aliya; Abu Muslim narrated to me, saying:
entries.matn_en: I asked Abu Dharr: "Which night prayer is best?" Abu Dharr said: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ as you have asked me, and he said: "The middle of the night, or the depth of the night," ('Awf was unsure which) "and few are those who do it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لَأَمَرْتُ بِالسِّوَاكِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ وُضُوءٍ ، وَلَأَخَّرْتُ الْعِشَاءَ إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ ، إِنَّهُ إِذَا مَضَى نِصْفُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ، ذَكَرَ نُزُولَهُ ، فَقَالَ: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Umar, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Were it not that I would burden my community, I would command the use of the siwak (tooth-stick) at every ablution, and I would delay the 'Isha' prayer until the middle of the night or a third of the night. For when the middle of the night or a third of the night has passed," [the narrator notes that he mentioned His descent; then:] "He says: 'Who is it that calls upon Me, that I may answer him? Who is it that asks of Me, that I may give him? Who is it that seeks My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?' until the sun rises."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْحَسنِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ بَاتَ طَاهِرًا بَاتَ فِي شِعَارِهِ مَلَكٌ ، فَلَا يَسْتَيْقِظُ سَاعَةً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِلَّا قَالَ الْمَلَكُ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِعَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ؛ فَإِنَّهُ بَاتَ طَاهِرًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from al-Hasan b. Dhakwan, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever spends the night in a state of purity, an angel spends the night in his clothing (next to his body), and he does not wake at any hour of the night except that the angel says: 'O God, forgive Your servant so-and-so, for he spent the night in a state of purity.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا حَدَّثَهُ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قِيلَ لِعُبَيْدٍ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِصَلَاةٍ غَيْرِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ؟ قَالَ: «بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah b. al-Mubarak informed us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, that a man narrated to him, saying:
entries.matn_en: 'Ubayd, the freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ, was asked: "Did the Messenger of God ﷺ command (any) prayer besides the obligatory one?" He said: "Between the Maghrib and the 'Isha'."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ ، عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها عَنْ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَتْ: «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَلْزَمُهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ أَحْرَى أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَهَا إِذَا كَانَ عَلَى حَدِيثٍ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ، وَمَا صَلَّاهَا قَطُّ ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيَّ إِلَّا صَلَّى بَعْدَهَا أَرْبَعًا أَوْ سِتًّا ، وَمَا رَأَيْتُهُ مُتَّقِيًا الْأَرْضَ بِشَيْءٍ قَطُّ ، إِلَّا أَنِّي أَذْكُرُ يَوْمَ مَطَرٍ فَإِنَّا بَسَطْنَا تَحْتَهُ بِسَاطًا أَوْ شَيْئًا ذَكَرَهُ، يَعْنِي نِطَعًا ، فَرَآنِي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى خَرْقٍ فِيهِ يَنْبُعُ مِنْهُ الْمَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Malik b. Mighwal, from Muqatil b. Bashir al-'Ijli, from Shurayh b. Hani', who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked 'A'isha (ؓ) about the prayer of the Messenger of God ﷺ. She said: "Nothing detained him from the prayer more surely than when he was engaged in conversation, (so he would delay) the 'Isha' prayer. Yet he never prayed it and then came in to me without praying four or six (units) after it. And I never saw him guard himself from the ground with anything, except that I remember a rainy day when we spread a mat under him, or something she mentioned, meaning a leather sheet, and he saw me looking at a tear in it from which water was seeping."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، حَدَّثَنِي حَبَّانُ بْنُ وَاسِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ الْمُنْذِرِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، أَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ فِي ثَلَاثٍ؟ قَالَ: «إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ» . قَالَ: فَكَانَ يَقْرؤُهُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قَيْسٍ الْأَوْدِيُّ ، عَنِ الْهُذَيْلِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ: «مَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِي قَطُّ إِلَّا صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a; Habban b. Wasi' narrated to me, from his father, from Sa'd b. al-Mundhir al-Ansari, that he said:
entries.matn_en: "O Messenger of God, may I recite the Qur'an in three (nights)?" He said: "If you are able." He (the narrator) said: So he used to recite it like that until he died. He (the narrator) said: And a man from the Ansar narrated to me, saying: Abu Qays al-Awdi narrated to me, from al-Hudhayl b. Shurahbil, from Masruq, from 'A'isha, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ never left me (my house) without praying two units."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, from 'Amir b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr, from 'Amr b. Sulaym, from Abu Qatada, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two units before he sits."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، أَخْبَرَنِي كَثِيرٌ الْأَعْرَجُ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا بِذِي الصَّوَارِي وَمَعَنَا أَبُو فَاطِمَةَ الْأَزْدِيُّ ، وَقَدِ اسْوَدَّتْ جَبْهَتُهُ وَرُكْبَتَاهُ مِنْ كَثْرَةِ السُّجُودِ ، فَقَالَ لَنَا ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «يَا أَبَا فَاطِمَةَ ، أَكْثِرْ مِنَ السُّجُودِ، فَإِنَّهِ لَيْسَ مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a; al-Harith b. Yazid narrated to me; Kathir al-A'raj informed me, saying:
entries.matn_en: We were at Dhu al-Sawari, and with us was Abu Fatima al-Azdi, whose forehead and knees had turned dark from much prostration. One day he said to us: The Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: "O Abu Fatima, increase your prostrations, for there is no Muslim servant who prostrates to God one prostration except that God raises him one degree by it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهْرًا ، فَبَقِيتُ فِي عَمَلِهِ كُلِّهِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ ، أَوْ زَاغَتْ ، أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ، إِنْ كَانَ فِي يَدِهِ عَمَلُ الدُّنْيَا رَفَضَهُ ، وَإِنْ كَانَ نَائِمًا فَكَأَنَّمَا نُوقِظُ لَهُ فَيَقُومُ فَيَغْتَسِلُ أَوْ يَتَوَضَّأُ ، ثُمَّ يَرْكَعُ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ يُتِمُّهُنَّ وَيُحْسِنُهُنَّ وَيَتَمَكَّنُ فِيهِنَّ ، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْطَلِقَ ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، مَكَثْتَ عِنْدِي شَهْرًا وَلَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّكَ مُلِئْتَ الْخَيْرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ، فَبَقِيتَ فِي عَمَلِكَ كُلِّهِ ، فَرَأَيْتُكَ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَوْ زَاغَتْ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي يَدِكَ عَمَلٌ رَفَضْتَهُ ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ نَائِمًا تُوقَظُ فَتَغْتَسِلُ أَوْ تَتَوَضَّأُ ، ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ تُتِمُّهُنَّ وَتُحْسِنُهُنَّ وَتَتَمَكَّنُ فِيهِنَّ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ وأَبْوابَ الْجَنَّةِ يُفتَحْنَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ ، فَلَا يُوَافِي أَحَدٌ بِهَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ يَصْعَدَ مِنِّي إِلَى رَبِّي فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ خَيْرٌ» ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: وَزَادَنِي الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ: فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ عَمَلِي فِي أَوَّلِ عَمَلِ الْعَابِدِينَ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yahya b. Ayyub, from 'Ubayd God b. Zahr, from 'Ali b. Yazid, from al-Qasim, from Abu Umama, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ stayed (with me) for a month, and I attended to all his needs. I saw that when the sun had passed its zenith, or declined, or as he said, if he had in his hand some worldly task he would put it aside; and if he were asleep, we would wake him; he would get up and wash or perform ablution, then pray four units, completing them, doing them well, and settling into them. When he was about to leave, I said: "O Messenger of God, you stayed with me a month, and I wished you could be filled with good from it. I attended to all your needs, and I saw that when the sun passed its zenith or declined, if there was some work in your hand you put it aside; if you were asleep you would be woken, and you would wash or make ablution, then pray four units, completing them, doing them well, and settling into them." The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The doors of heaven and the doors of Paradise are opened at that hour, and no one performs this prayer (at that time) but that it is accepted (or: no one meets it with this prayer without...). So I loved that something good of mine should ascend to my Lord at that hour." 'Abd Allah said: And al-Awza'i added for me: He said: "So I love that my deed be raised among the first of the deeds of the worshippers."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ ذَرٍّ ، عَنْ يُسَيْعٍ ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ هَوَ الْعِبَادَةُ ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ} [غَافِر: 60] » ، حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ نَحْوًا مِنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Shu'ba, from Mansur, from Dharr, from Yusay', from al-Nu'man b. Bashir, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: "Supplication is worship." Then he recited: *"And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you'"* [Ghafir 40:60]. My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; he said: And Sufyan informed me of something similar to it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: أَنَّ عَمَّارَ بْنَ يَاسِرٍ ، دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ: قَدْ حَفِظْتُهُمَا يَا أَبَا الْيَقْظَانِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرَأَيْتَنِي نَقَصْتُ مِنْ حُدُودِهَا شَيْئًا ، وَلَكِنْ خَفَّفْتُهُمَا ، بَادَرْتُ بِهِمَا السَّهْوَ ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُصَلِّي الصَّلَاةَ وَلَعَلَّهُ لَا يَكُونُ لَهُ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ إِلَّا عُشْرُهَا أَوْ تُسْعُهَا أَوْ ثُمُنُهَا أَوْ سُبُعُهَا أَوْ خُمُسُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Umar, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from 'Umar b. Abi Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham, from his father: 'Ammar b. Yasir entered the mosque and prayed two light units. A man said to him: "I have memorized them (observed them), O Abu al-Yaqzan." He said:
entries.matn_en: "Do you think I diminished anything of their limits? Rather I made them light, hastening in them against heedlessness. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'A man may pray a prayer and perhaps he receives from his prayer only a tenth of it, or a ninth, or an eighth, or a seventh, or a fifth.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ زَائِدَةَ بْنِ قُدَامَةَ ، نَا السَّائِبُ بْنُ حُبَيْشٍ الْكَلَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: أَيْنَ مَسْكَنُكَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: فِي قَرْيَةٍ دُونَ حِمْصَ ، فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «مَا مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ فِي قَرْيَةٍ وَلَا بَدْوٍ لَا تُقَامُ فِيهِمُ الصَّلَاةُ إِلَّا اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ ، فَعَلَيْكَ بِالْجَمَاعَةِ فَإِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ الذِّئْبُ الْقَاصِيَةَ» ، قَالَ السَّائِبُ: " يَعْنِي بِالْجَمَاعَةِ: الْجَمَاعَةَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Za'ida b. Qudama; al-Sa'ib b. Hubaysh al-Kala'i narrated to us, from Ma'dan b. Abi Talha al-Ya'mari, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu al-Darda' said to me: "Where is your dwelling?" I said: "In a village near Hims." Abu al-Darda' said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "There are not three people in a village or in the desert among whom the prayer is not established, except that Satan has gained mastery over them. So keep to the congregation, for the wolf eats only the straggler." Al-Sa'ib said: "He means by the congregation: the congregation in prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَني جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ لَمْ يَدَعِ الزُّورَ وَالْعَمَلَ بِهِ وَالْجَهْلَ ، فَلَيْسَ لِلَّهِ حَاجَةٌ بِأَنْ يَدَعَ طَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever does not abandon false speech and acting upon it, and ignorance, God has no need of his giving up his food and drink."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رُبَّ صَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ صِيَامِهِ إِلَّا الْجُوعُ ، وَرُبَّ قَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ قِيَامِهِ إِلَّا السَّهَرُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Usama b. Zayd, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "How many a fasting person gains nothing from his fast except hunger, and how many a person standing in night prayer gains nothing from his standing except sleeplessness."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَنْفَقَ زَوْجَيْنِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ نُودِيَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ، هَذَا خَيْرٌ ، فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصَّلَاةِ دُعِيَ مِنْ بَابِ الصَّلَاةِ ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصَّدَقَةِ دُعِيَ مِنْ بَابِ الصَّدَقَةِ ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجِهَادِ دُعِيَ مِنْ بَابِ الْجِهَادِ ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصِّيَامِ دُعِيَ مِنْ بَابِ الرَّيَّانِ» ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، مَا عَلَى أَحَدٍ يُدْعَى مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَبْوَابِ مِنْ ضَرُورَةٍ ، فَهَلْ أَحَدٌ يُدْعَى مِنَ الْأَبْوَابِ كُلِّهَا؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ ، وَأَرْجُو أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Malik informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Whoever spends a pair (of anything) in the cause of God will be called in Paradise: 'O servant of God, this is good.' If he was among the people of prayer, he will be called from the gate of prayer; if he was among the people of charity, he will be called from the gate of charity; if he was among the people of jihad, he will be called from the gate of jihad; and if he was among the people of fasting, he will be called from the gate of al-Rayyan." Abu Bakr said: "May my father and mother be your ransom, O Messenger of God! There is no necessity upon anyone who is called from one of these gates; but will anyone be called from all of the gates?" He said: "Yes, and I hope you will be among them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَحَبَّ الْأَعْمَالِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ» ، وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِذَا عَمِلَتْ عَمَلًا دَاوَمَتْ عَلَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Sa'd b. Sa'id al-Ansari, that al-Qasim b. Muhammad narrated to him from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The most beloved deeds to God are the most constant of them, even if few." And whenever 'A'isha did a deed, she kept it up constantly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنا يَحْيَى بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «طُوبَى لِمَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ ، وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Yahya b. 'Ubayd God informed us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard my father say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Glad tidings to him whose life is long and whose deeds are good."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْخَبَرَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ مَيْمُونٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ السُّلَمِيِّ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ السُّلَمِيِّ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم آخَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ فَقُتِلَ أَحَدُهُمَا ، وَمَاتَ الْآخَرُ بَعْدَهُ ، فَصَلَّيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا قُلْتُمْ؟» ، قَالُوا: دَعَوْنَا لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ ، اللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْهُ بِصَاحِبِهِ ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَأَيْنَ صَلَاتُهُ بَعْدَ صَلَاتِهِ ، وَأَيْنَ عَمَلُهُ بَعْدَ عَمَلِهِ؟، وَأُرَاهُ قَالَ: صَوْمُهُ بَعْدَ صَوْمِهِ، فَإِنَّ بَيْنَهُمَا كَمَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ» ، قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ: «أَعْجَبَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ لِأَنَّهُ أُسْنِدَ لِي»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Shu'ba (and he did not mention the report from 'Amr b. Murra), who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Amr b. Maymun relate from 'Abd Allah b. Rabi'a al-Sulami, who was one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, from 'Ubayd b. Khalid al-Sulami, who was one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ: that the Prophet ﷺ made two men brothers (in faith); one of them was killed, and the other died after him. We prayed over him, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "What did you say?" They said: "We prayed for him: 'O God, forgive him; O God, join him to his companion.'" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Then where is his prayer after his (companion's) prayer? Where is his deed after his deed?" and I think he said, "his fasting after his fasting? For indeed between the two is as between heaven and earth." 'Amr b. Maymun said: "This hadith pleased me because it was transmitted to me with a connected chain (musnad)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَني جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ: إِمَامٌ عَادِلٌ ، وَشَابٌّ نَشَأَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ عز وجل ، وَرَجُلٌ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ فِي خَلًا فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ ، وَرَجُلٌ كَانَ قَلْبُهُ مُعَلَّقٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ، وَرَجُلَانِ تَحَابَّا فِي اللَّهِ ، وَرَجُلٌ دَعَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وَجَمَالٍ إِلَى نَفْسِهَا فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ ، وَرَجُلٌ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدقَةٍ فَأَخْفَاهَا حَتَّى لَا تَعْلَمَ شِمَالُهُ مَا صَنَعَتْ يَمِينُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Umar, from Khubayb b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs b. 'Asim b. 'Umar, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Seven will God shade in His shade on the Day of Resurrection, on a day when there is no shade but His shade: a just ruler; a young man who grew up in obedience to God, the Mighty and Majestic; a man who remembered God in solitude and his eyes overflowed; a man whose heart is attached to the mosque; two men who loved each other for God's sake; a man whom a woman of rank and beauty called to herself and he said: 'I fear God'; and a man who gave charity and concealed it so that his left hand did not know what his right hand had spent."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ ، يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ، خُذُوا عَلَى أَيْدِي سُفَهَائِكُمْ ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ قَوْمًا رَكِبُوا الْبَحْرَ فِي سَفِينَةٍ فَاقْتَسَمُوهَا ، فَأَصَابَ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مَكَانًا فَأَخَذَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمُ الْفَأْسَ فَبَقَرَ مَكَانَهُ ، فَقَالُوا: مَا يَصْنَعُ؟ قَالَ هُوَ: إِنِّي أَصْنَعُ فِيهِ مَا شِئْتُ ، فَإِنْ أَخَذُوا عَلَى يَدَيْهِ نَجَوْا وَنَجَا ، وَإِنْ تَرَكُوهُ غَرِقَ وَغَرِقُوا ، فَخُذُوا عَلَى أَيْدِي سُفَهَائِكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَهْلَكُوا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from al-A'mash, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir say upon the pulpit: "O people, take hold of the hands of your fools, for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'A group of people boarded a ship at sea and drew lots for places on it, and each man got a place. One of them took an axe and began to cut into his place. They said: "What are you doing?" He said: "I am doing with my place what I wish." If they take hold of his hands, they will be saved and he will be saved; and if they leave him, he will drown and they will drown. So take hold of the hands of your fools before they perish.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ االْإِسْفِرَاِييِنُّي بِقِرَاءَتِي عَلَيْهِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو الْفَرَج سَهْلُ بْنُ بِشْرِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْإِسْفِرَايِينِيُّ، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، أَنا أَبُو الْفَرَجِ عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بُرْهَانٍ الْغَزَّالُ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ بِثُغْرِ صُورَ أَنا أَبُو يَعْقُوبَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَسْعَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ الْفَسَوِيُّ فِي صَفَرَ سَنَةَ اثْنَتَيْنِ وَسَبْعِينِ وَثَلَاثِمِائَةٍ أَنا جَدِّي أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ اْلحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، نَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَي، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا أَحَبَّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَعْلَمَ قَدْرَ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ تَحْتَهُ ، وَلَا يَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: The Shaykh Abu al-Qasim al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Muhammad al-Isfarayini informed us, by my reading to him, saying:
entries.matn_en: The Shaykh Abu al-Faraj Sahl b. Bishr b. Ahmad al-Isfarayini informed us, by reading to him; Abu al-Faraj 'Abd al-Wahhab b. al-Husayn b. Burhan al-Ghazzal al-Baghdadi informed us at the frontier fortress of Tyre; Abu Ya'qub Ishaq b. As'ad b. al-Hasan b. Sufyan al-Fasawi informed us in Safar of the year 372 (AH); my grandfather Abu al-'Abbas al-Hasan b. Sufyan informed us; Habban b. Musa narrated to us; 'Abd Allah b. al-Mubarak informed us, from Yahya b. 'Ubayd God, who said: I heard my father say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When one of you wishes to know the measure of God's favor upon him, let him look at those who are beneath him, and not look at those who are above him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَنْ يَلِجَ أَحَدٌ بِعَمَلِهِ الْجَنَّةَ» ، قَالُوا: وَلَا أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «وَلَا أَنَا ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ ، أَوْ تَسَعَنِي مِنْهُ عَافِيَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yahya b. 'Ubayd God, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard my father say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "No one will enter Paradise by his deeds." They said: "Not even you, O Messenger of God?" He said: "Not even I, unless God envelops me in His mercy," or, "unless well-being from Him embraces me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ ، أَنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنَ الْيَمَانِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَامَ سَائِلٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْأَلُ فَأَمْسَكَ الْقَوْمُ ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَجُلًا أَعْطَاهُ فَأَعْطَى الْقَوْمُ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنِ اسْتَنَّ خَيْرًا فَاسْتُنَّ بِهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ ، وَمِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ مُنْتَقِصٍ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْئًا ، وَمَنِ اسْتَنَّ شرًّا فَاسْتُنَّ بِهِ فَعَلَيْهِ وِزْرُهُ ، وَمِثْلُ أَوْزَارِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ غَيْرَ مُنْتَقِصٍ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Hisham b. Hassan, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu 'Ubayda b. Hudhayfa, that Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman said:
entries.matn_en: A beggar stood up in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ asking for alms, and the people held back. Then a man gave him something, and the people gave. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Whoever initiates a good practice and is followed in it has his reward, and the like of the rewards of those who follow him, without diminishing anything of their rewards. And whoever initiates an evil practice and is followed in it bears its burden, and the like of the burdens of those who follow him, without diminishing anything of their burdens."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا أَعْرِفُ مِنْكُمْ شَيْئًا كُنْتُ أَعْهَدُهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ قَوْلُكُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» ، قُلْنَا: يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ الصَّلَاةَ؟ قَالَ: «قَدْ صَلَّيْتُمْ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ ، أَوَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ صَلَاةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ ثُمَّ قَالَ: عَلَى أَنِّي لَمْ أَرَ زَمَانًا خَيْرًا لِلْعَامِلِ مِنْ زَمَانِكُمْ هَذَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Sulayman b. al-Mughira, from Thabit, from Anas, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I do not recognize anything among you of what I knew in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ, except your saying 'There is no god but God.'" We said: "O Abu Hamza, (what about) the prayer?" He said: "You pray at sunset (i.e., you delay it until the sun is setting)! Was that the prayer of the Messenger of God ﷺ?" Then he said: "Yet I have not seen a time better for the doer of good deeds than this time of yours."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا انْتَهَتْ عِدَّةُ زَيْنَبَ ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِزَيْدٍ: «اذْكُرْهَا عَلَيَّ» . قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقْتُ ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا زَيْنَبُ ، أَبْشِرِي ، أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُذكِّرُكَ ، فَقَالَتْ: «مَا أَنَا بِصَانِعَةٍ شَيْئًا حَتَّى أُوَامِرَ رَبِّي ، فَقَامَتْ إِلَى مَسْجِدِهَا وَنَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ ، وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Sulayman b. al-Mughira, from Thabit, from Anas, who said:
entries.matn_en: When Zaynab's waiting period ended, the Messenger of God ﷺ said to Zayd: "Mention her to me (propose to her on my behalf)." He said: So I went and said: "O Zaynab, good news! The Messenger of God ﷺ has sent (me) to mention you (to you)." She said: "I will do nothing until I consult my Lord." So she stood in her place of prayer, and the Qur'an was revealed, and the Messenger of God ﷺ came and entered upon her without permission.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيْنِ» ، وَكَانَ إِذَا ذَكَرَ السَّاعَةَ احْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ ، وَعَلَا صَوْتُهُ ، وَاشْتَدَّ غَضَبُهُ كَأَنَّهُ مُنْذِرُ جَيْشٍ صَبَّحَكُمْ وَمَسَّاكُمْ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Sufyan, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I and the Hour have been sent like these two," and when he mentioned the Hour his cheeks would redden, his voice would rise and his anger would intensify, as if he were a warner of an army saying: "It has come upon you in the morning and in the evening."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ بِنَهَارٍ ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَنَا إِلَى أَنْ غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ ، فَلَمْ يَدَعْ شَيْئًا يَكُونُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَّا حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ ، حَفِظَهُ مَنْ حَفِظَهُ وَنَسِيَهُ مَنْ نَسِيَهُ ، وَقَالَ حِينَ ذَهَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ: «إِنَّمَا مَضَى مِنْ دُنْيَاكُمْ فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهَا كَمَا مَضَى مِنْ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Mu'tamir informed us, from 'Ali b. Zayd, from Abu Nadra, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ led us in the 'Asr prayer while it was still day, then addressed us until the sun set. He left nothing that would occur until the Day of Resurrection without telling us of it; whoever memorized it memorized it, and whoever forgot it forgot it. And when the sun was going down in the west, he said: "What has passed of your world, compared to what remains of it, is like what has passed of this day of yours compared to what remains of it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي، ثَنَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُنْهَزِمِ ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَتَقُومَنَّ السَّاعَةُ عَلَى رَجُلَيْنِ وثَوْبُهُمَا فِي أَيْدِيهِمَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Hammad b. Salama narrated to us, from Abu al-Munhazim, I heard Abu Hurayra say:
entries.matn_en: "The Hour will surely come upon two men while their cloth is in their hands (i.e., while they are trading cloth, in the midst of their business)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ نَا خَالِدٌ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «كَيْفَ أَنْعَمُ وَصَاحِبُ الْقَرْنِ قَدِ الْتَقَمَ الْقَرْنَ ، وَاسْتَمَعَ الْإِذْنَ مَتَى يُؤْمَرُ بِالنَّفْخِ فَيَنْفُخُ؟» فكَأَنَّ ذَلِكَ ثَقُلَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ قُولُوا: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ ، عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا "
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Khalid Abu al-'Ala' narrated to us, from 'Atiyya, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "How can I be at ease when the one with the Horn has put the Horn to his mouth and is listening for the permission, (waiting) for when he will be commanded to blow, and will blow?" That seemed heavy on the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, so at that point he said to them: "Say: 'God is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs; in God we have put our trust.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَناُ عبد اللَّهِ بن الْمُبَارك عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ شَغَافٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ: مَا الصُّورُ؟ فَقَالَ: «قَرْنٌ يُنْفَخُ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah b. al-Mubarak informed us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Aslam, from Bishr b. Shaghaf, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, who said:
entries.matn_en: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "What is the Sur?" He said: "A horn that is blown."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، وَيَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ بِيَمِينِهِ ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: أَنَا الْمَلِكُ ، أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الْأَرْضِ ؟»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "God will seize the earth on the Day of Resurrection and fold up the heavens in His right hand, then say: 'I am the King. Where are the kings of the earth?'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا} [الزلزلة: 4] ، قَالَ: «أَتَدْرُونَ مَا أَخْبَارُهَا؟» قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ، قَالَ: «فَإِنَّ أَخْبَارَهَا أَنْ تَشْهَدَ عَلَى كُلِّ عَبْدٍ وَأَمَةٍ بِمَا عَمِلَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا ، أَنْ تَقُولَ: عَمِلَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فِي يَوْمِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ، فَهَذِهِ أَخْبَارُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub informed us; Ibn Abi Sulayman narrated to me, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ recited this verse: *"That Day, it will report its news"* [al-Zalzala 99:4]. He said: "Do you know what its news is?" They said: "God and His Messenger know best." He said: "Its news is that it will bear witness against every male and female servant concerning what he did upon its back, saying: 'He did such-and-such on such-and-such a day.' That is its news."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: « {يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [المطففين: 6] حَتَّى يَغِيبَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ» ، حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِيهِ صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.matn_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn 'Awn, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said (regarding): *"The Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds"* [al-Mutaffifin 83:6]: "(They will stand) until one of them is submerged in his sweat up to the middle of his ears." My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; he said: And Sakhr b. Juwayriya informed me of it, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي الْمِقْدَادُ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أُدْنِيَتِ الشَّمْسُ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ حَتَّى تَكُونَ قَيْدَ مِيلٍ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ» ، قَالَ سُلَيْمٌ: لَا أَدْرِي أَيُّ الْمِيلَيْنِ يَعْنِي: أَمَسَافَةُ الْأَرْضِ أَوِ الْمِيلُ الَّذِي تُكْتَحَلُ بِهِ الْعَيْنُ، قَالَ: «فَتَصْهَرُهُمُ الشَّمْسُ فَيَكُونُونَ فِي الْعَرَقِ بِقَدْرِ أَعْمَالِهِمْ ، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَأْخُذُهُ الْعَرَقُ إِلَى عَقِبَيْهِ ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَأْخُذُهُ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَأْخُذُهُ إِلَى حَقْوَيْهِ ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُلْجِمُهُ إِلْجَامًا» ، قَالَ: فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَهُوَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى فِيهِ يَقُولُ: «يُلْجِمُهُ إِلْجَامًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid b. Jabir; Sulaym b. 'Amir narrated to me; al-Miqdad, a Companion of the Messenger of God ﷺ, narrated to me, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "On the Day of Resurrection the sun will be brought near to the servants until it is at the distance of a mile or two." Sulaym said: I do not know which "mile" he meant, whether the measure of distance on the earth or the mil (stick) with which the eye is lined with kohl. He said: "The sun will melt them, and they will be in sweat according to their deeds: among them are those whom sweat reaches to their heels, and among them are those whom it reaches to their knees, and among them are those whom it reaches to their waists, and among them are those whom it bridles like a bridle." He (al-Miqdad) said: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pointing with his hand to his mouth, saying: "It bridles him like a bridle."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ رِشْدِينَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ حُيَيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الصِّيَامُ وَالْقُرْآنُ يَشْفَعَانِ لِلْعَبْدِ ، يَقُولُ الصِّيَامُ: أَيْ رَبِّ ، إِنِّي مَنَعْتُهُ الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّهَوَاتِ بِالنَّهَارِ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ ، وَيَقُولُ الْقُرْآنُ: رَبِّ ، إِنِّي مَنَعْتُهُ النَّومَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ ، فَيُشَفَّعَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Rishdin b. Sa'd, from Huyayy b. 'Abd Allah, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Fasting and the Qur'an will intercede for the servant. Fasting will say: 'O my Lord, I prevented him from food and desires during the day, so let me intercede for him.' And the Qur'an will say: 'My Lord, I prevented him from sleep at night, so let me intercede for him.' And they will be allowed to intercede."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي الدِّمَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to me; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Shu'ba, from Sulayman, from Abu Wa'il, from Ibn Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The first matter to be judged between people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، أَنا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، وَقَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُؤْتَى بِالْعَبْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُ بَذَجٌ فَيُوقَفُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: أَعْطَيْتُكَ وَخَوَّلْتُكَ وَأَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ فَمَا صَنَعْتَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ ، جَمَعْتُهُ وَثَمَّرْتُهُ وَتَرَكْتُهُ أَكْثَرَ مَا كَانَ ، فَارْجِعْنِي آتِكَ بِهِ كُلِّهِ ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ: أَرِنِي مَا قَدَّمْتَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ ، جَمَعْتُهُ وَثَمَّرْتُهُ وَتَرَكْتُهُ أَكْثَرَ مَا كَانَ ، فَارْجِعْنِي آتِكَ بِهِ كُلِّهِ ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عَبْدٌ لَمْ يُقَدِّمْ خَيْرًا فَيَمْضِي بِهِ إِلَى النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban informed us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Isma'il b. Muslim, from al-Hasan and Qatada, from Anas b. Malik, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "A servant will be brought on the Day of Resurrection, as if he were a lamb, and made to stand before God. God will say: 'I gave you, granted you, and bestowed favor on you. What did you do?' He will say: 'My Lord, I gathered it, I multiplied it, and I left it more than it was; so send me back and I will bring it all to You.' He will say to him: 'Show Me what you sent ahead.' He will say: 'My Lord, I gathered it, I multiplied it and I left it more than it was; so send me back and I will bring it all to You.' And if it is a servant who sent ahead nothing good, he will be taken away to the Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ هَلَكَ» ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: {فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا} [الانشقاق: 8] ، قَالَ: «ذَلِكَ الْعَرْضُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from 'Uthman b. al-Aswad, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "Whoever is questioned closely in the reckoning is destroyed." I said: "O Messenger of God, but God says: *'As for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will be judged with an easy account'* [al-Inshiqaq 84:7–8]." He said: "That is the presentation (of deeds)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، نَا عَامِرُ بْنُ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ ثُمَّ الْحُبُلِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ سَيُخَلِّصُ رَجُلًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، فَيَنْشُرُ عَلَيْهِ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ سِجِلًّا ، كُلُّ سِجِلٍّ مَدَّ الْبَصَرِ ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لَهُ: أَتُنكِرُ مِنْ هَذَا شَيْئًا؟ أَظَلَمَكَ كَتَبَتِي الْحَافِظُونَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: لَا يَا رَبِّ. فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: أَلَكَ عُذْرٌ أَوْ حَسَنَةٌ ؟ فَبُهِتَ الرَّجُلُ ، وَقَالَ: لَا يَا رَبِّ. فَيَقُولُ: بَلَى ، إِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَنَا حَسَنَةً ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا ظُلْمَ عَلَيْكَ الْيَوْمَ ، فَتُخْرَجُ لَهُ بِطَاقَةٌ فِيهَا: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، فَيَقُولُ: احْضُرْ وَزْنَكَ ، فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ ، فَمَا هَذِهِ الْبِطَاقَةُ مَعَ هَذِهِ السِّجِلَّاتِ؟ فَيَقُولُ: إِنَّكَ لَا تُظْلَمُ ، قَالَ: فَتُوضَعُ السِّجِلَّاتُ فِي كِفَّةٍ وَالْبِطَاقَةُ فِي كِفَّةٍ ، فَطَاشَتِ السِّجِلَّاتُ ، وَثَقُلَتِ الْبِطَاقَةُ وَلَا يَثْقُلُ مَعَ اسْمِ اللَّهِ شَيْءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Layth b. Sa'd; 'Amir b. Yahya narrated to us, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ma'afiri, then al-Hubuli, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "God, glory be to Him, will single out a man from my community before all of creation on the Day of Resurrection, and will spread out before him ninety-nine scrolls, each scroll as far as the eye can see. Then He will say to him: 'Do you deny anything of this? Have My recording scribes wronged you?' He will say: 'No, my Lord.' God will say: 'Do you have an excuse or a good deed?' The man will be dumbfounded and say: 'No, my Lord.' He will say: 'Yes, you have with Us a good deed, and there is no wrong against you today.' Then a card will be brought out for him on which is: 'I bear witness that there is no god but God, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.' He will say: 'Be present for your weighing.' He will say: 'My Lord, what is this card beside these scrolls?' He will say: 'You will not be wronged.'" He said: "The scrolls will be placed in one pan of the scale and the card in the other pan; the scrolls will fly up (be light) and the card will be heavy; and nothing is heavy against the Name of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنْبَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلَحْمٍ فَرُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ الذِّرَاعُ ، وَكَانَتْ تُعْجِبُهُ ، فَنَهَسَ مِنْهَا نَهْسَةً ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، هَلْ تَدْرُونَ بِمَ ذَاكَ؟ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ ، يُسْمِعُهُمُ الدَّاعِي وَيَنْفُذُهُمُ الْبَصَرُ وَتَدْنُو الشَّمْسُ ، فَيَبْلُغُ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَالْكَرْبِ مَا لَا يُطِيقُونَ وَلَا يَحْتَمِلُونَ ، فَيَقُولُ النَّاسُ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ: أَلَا تَرَوْنَ مَا قَدْ بَلَغَكُمْ ، أَلَا تَنْظُرُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَكُمْ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ ، فَيَقُولُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لِبَعْضٍ: عَلَيْكُمْ بِآدَمَ ، فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ ، فَيَقُولُونَ: أَنْتَ أَبُو الْبَشَرِ ، خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ ، وَنَفَخَ فِيكَ مِنْ رُوحِهِ ، وَأَمَرَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ فَسَجَدُوا لَكَ ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ أَلَا تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا؟ فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ آدَمُ: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نَهَانِي عَنِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَصَيْتُهُ ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى نُوحٍ ، فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا ، فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا نُوحُ ، أَنْتَ أَوَّلُ الرُّسُلِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ وَقَدْ سَمَّاكَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ ، أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ أَلَا تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا؟ قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَتْ لِي دَعْوَةٌ دَعَوْتُهَا عَلَى قَوْمِي ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، أَنْتَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ وَخَلِيلُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ ، أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ كَذَبْتُ ثَلَاثَ كِذْبَاتٍ، فَذَكَرَهُنَّ أَبُو حَيَّانَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُوسَى ، فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى ، فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا مُوسَى ، أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، فَضَّلَكَ بِرِسَالَاتِهِ وَبِتَكْلِيمِهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ فَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَإِنِّي قَتَلْتُ نَفْسًا لَمْ أُومَرْ بِقَتْلِهَا ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى عِيسَى ، فَيَأْتُونَ فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا عِيسَى ، أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ ، وَكَلَّمْتَ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ ، أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ فَيَقُولُ عِيسَى: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَنْبًا ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي ، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ ، أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَخَاتمُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ ، أَلَا تَرَى مَا نَحنُ فِيهِ؟ فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَآتِي تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ فَأَقَعُ سَاجِدًا لِرَبِّي ، ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ عَلَيَّ مِنْ مَحَامِدِهِ وَحُسْنِ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْتَحْهُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ قَبْلِي ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ ، سَلْ تُعْطَهْ ، اشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ ، فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي ، فَأَقُولُ: أُمَّتِي يَا رَبِّ ، أُمَّتِي. فَيُقَالُ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَدْخِلْ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ مَنْ لَا حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْبَابِ الْأَيْمَنِ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ ، وَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ النَّاسِ فِيمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْأَبْوَابِ. قَالَ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ ، إِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ الْمِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَهَجَرَ أَوْ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَبُصْرَى»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Abu Hayyan al-Taymi, from Abu Zur'a b. 'Amr b. Jarir, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: Meat was brought to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and the foreleg was raised to him, and he liked it. He bit off a piece of it, then said: "I am the master of the people on the Day of Resurrection. Do you know why? God will gather the first and the last people on one plain, so that the caller can make them all hear and the sight can penetrate them all, and the sun will draw near. The people will be afflicted with distress and anguish that they cannot bear or endure. Some people will say to others: 'Do you not see what has reached you? Will you not look for someone who will intercede for you with your Lord?' Some people will say to others: 'Go to Adam.' So they will go to Adam and say: 'You are the father of mankind. God created you with His hand, breathed into you of His spirit, and commanded the angels, who prostrated to you. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in? Do you not see what has reached us?' Adam will say to them: 'My Lord is angry today with an anger such as He has never been angry with before and will never be angry with after. He forbade me the tree and I disobeyed Him. Myself, myself! Go to someone else. Go to Noah.' So they will go to Noah and say: 'O Noah, you are the first of the messengers to the people of the earth, and God called you a grateful servant. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in? Do you not see what has reached us?' He will say: 'My Lord is angry today with an anger such as He has never been angry with before and will never be angry with after. I had one supplication that I made against my people. Myself, myself! Go to someone else. Go to Abraham.' So they will go to Abraham and say: 'O Abraham, you are the Prophet of God and His intimate friend among the people of the earth. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in?' He will say to them: 'My Lord is angry today with an anger such as He has never been angry with before and will never be angry with after. I told three lies,'" and Abu Hayyan mentioned them in the hadith. "'Myself, myself! Go to someone else. Go to Moses.' So they will go to Moses and say: 'O Moses, you are the Messenger of God, whom He preferred over the people with His messages and by speaking to him. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in?' He will say: 'My Lord is angry today with an anger such as He has never been angry with before and will never be angry with after. I killed a person whom I had not been commanded to kill. Myself, myself! Go to someone else. Go to Jesus.' So they will go and say: 'O Jesus, you are the Messenger of God, and His Word which He cast to Mary, and a spirit from Him, and you spoke to people in the cradle. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in?' Jesus will say: 'My Lord is angry today with an anger such as He has never been angry with before and will never be angry with after,'" and he did not mention a sin. "'Myself, myself! Go to someone else. Go to Muhammad ﷺ.' So they will say: 'O Muhammad, you are the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets. God has forgiven you what preceded of your sin and what will follow. Intercede for us with your Lord. Do you not see what we are in?' So I will go and come beneath the Throne and fall prostrate to my Lord. Then He will open to me some of His praises and beautiful expressions of glorification that He has not opened to anyone before me. Then it will be said: 'O Muhammad, raise your head; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted.' So I will raise my head and say: 'My community, my Lord! My community!' It will be said: 'O Muhammad, admit from your community those who have no reckoning against them through the right-hand gate of the gates of Paradise; and they share with the people in the other gates besides that.'" He said: "By Him in whose hand is my soul, the distance between the two leaves of a gate of Paradise is like the distance between Mecca and Hajar, or like the distance between Mecca and Busra."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رِشْدِينَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، أَنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادِ عَنِ دُخَيْنٍ الْحَجْرِي ُّ ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يَقُولُ عِيسَى: هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ ، فَيَأْتُونِي ، فَيَأْذَنُ اللَّهُ لِي أَنْ أَقُومَ ، فَيَثُورَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِي أَطْيَبُ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ ، حَتَّى آتِيَ رَبِّي فَيُشَفِّعَنِي ، وَيَجْعَلَ لِيَ نُورًا مِنْ شَعْرِ رَأْسِي إِلَى ظُفُرِ قَدَمِي ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ الْكُفَّارُ: قَدْ وَجَدَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَهُمْ فَمَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَنَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: مَا هُوَ غَيْرُ إِبْلِيسَ هُوَ الَّذِي أَضَلَّنَا ، فَيَأْتُونَهُ ، فَيَقُومُ فَيَثُورُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ أَنْتَنُ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ ، ثُمَّ يُورِدُهُمْ لِجَهَنَّمَ، وَيَقُولُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ {وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدْتُكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ} [إِبْرَاهِيم: 22] الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Rishdin b. Sa'd; 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ziyad informed us, from Dukhayn al-Hajri, from 'Uqba b. 'Amir, that the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he mentioned the hadith, said:
entries.matn_en: "Jesus will say: 'Shall I direct you to the unlettered Prophet?' So they will come to me, and God will give me permission to stand, and the most fragrant scent anyone has ever smelled will rise from where I sit, until I come to my Lord and He grants my intercession, and makes for me a light from the hair of my head to the nail of my foot. Then the disbelievers will say: 'The believers have found someone to intercede for them; who will intercede for us?' They will say: 'It is none other than Iblis; he is the one who led us astray.' So they will come to him, and he will stand, and the foulest stench anyone has ever smelled will rise from where he sits. Then he will lead them down to Hell, and at that point he will say: *'And Satan will say when the matter has been decided: "Indeed, God had promised you the promise of truth, and I promised you, but I failed you"'* [Ibrahim 14:22]," (to the end of) the verse.

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا ذَرٍّ ، وَأَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ ، قَالَا: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُؤْذَنُ لِي فِي السُّجُودِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، وَأَوَّلُ مَنْ يُؤْذَنُ لَهُ بِرَفْعِ رَأْسِهِ ، فَأَنْظُرُ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ فَأَعْرِفُ أُمَّتِي مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأُمَمِ ، وَأَنْظُرُ عَنْ يَمِينِي فَأَعْرِفُ أُمَّتِي مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأُمَمِ ، وَأَنْظُرُ عَنْ شِمَالِي فَأَعْرِفُ أُمَّتِي مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأُمَمِ ، وَأَنْظُرُ خَلْفِي فَأَعْرِفُ أُمَّتِي مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأُمَمِ» ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ، كَيْفَ تَعْرِفُ أُمَّتَكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأُمَمِ مَا بَيْنَ نُوحٍ إِلَى أُمَّتِكَ؟ فَقَالَ: «غُرٌّ مُحَجَّلُونَ مِنْ آثَارِ الْوُضُوءِ ، وَلَا يَكُونُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ غَيْرَهُمْ ، وَأَعْرِفُهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ يُؤْتَوْنَ كُتُبَهُمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ ، فَأَعْرِفُهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ، وَأَعْرِفُهُمْ بِنُورهِمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ دُونَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Lahi'a; Yazid b. Abi Habib narrated to me, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Jubayr, that he heard Abu Dharr and Abu al-Darda' say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I will be the first to be given permission to prostrate on the Day of Resurrection, and the first to be given permission to raise his head. I will look before me and recognize my community among the (other) communities; I will look to my right and recognize my community among the communities; I will look to my left and recognize my community among the communities; and I will look behind me and recognize my community among the communities." A man said: "O Prophet of God, how will you recognize your community among the communities from Noah to your community?" He said:
entries.matn_en: "They will be radiant in the face and limbs from the traces of ablution, and no one among the nations will be so but them. I will recognize them by their being given their records in their right hands; I will recognize them by their mark upon their faces from the trace of prostration; and I will recognize them by their light that runs before them and beside them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ أُمَّتِي مِثْلُ اللَّيْلِ أَوِ السَّيلِ ، فَيَخْطَفُ النَّاسَ خَطْفَةً وَاحِدَةً ، فَيَقُولُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ: لَمَا جَاءَ مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا جَاءَ مَعَ سَائِرِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Musa b. 'Ubayda, from Ayyub b. Khalid, from 'Abd Allah b. Nafi', from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "On the Day of Resurrection there will come with my community something like the night, or the flood, and it will snatch people up in a single snatch. The angels will say: 'What has come with Muhammad is more than what has come with all the other prophets.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَذْكُرُ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةً قَدْ دَعَا بِهَا ، وَإِنِّي اسْتَخْبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Hisham; I heard al-Hasan relate from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Every prophet has a supplication that he has already made, and I have kept my supplication hidden as intercession for my community on the Day of Resurrection."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ بَهْزِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّكُمْ تُوفُونَ سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً، أَنْتُمْ خَيْرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا عَلَى اللَّهِ عز وجل»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Bahz b. Hakim, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "You complete seventy communities; you are the best of them and the most honored of them with God, the Mighty and Majestic."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «نَحنُ الْآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، وذَلِكَ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ أُوتُوهُ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ، وَأُوتِينَاهُ مِنْ بَعدِهِمْ ، فَهَذَا يَومُهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ، فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهُ فَهُمْ لَنَا فِيهِ تَبَعٌ الْيَهُودُ غَدًا وَالنَّصَارَى بَعْدَ غَدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yahya b. 'Ubayd God, who said: 'I heard my father say:
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "We are the last, yet the foremost, on the Day of Resurrection. That is because the People of the Book were given the Book before us, and we were given it after them. This is their day about which they differed, and God guided us to it; so they follow us in it: the Jews tomorrow and the Christians the day after tomorrow."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، أَنَّ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ أُقَيْشٍ ، حَدَّثَ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لَمَنْ يَعْظُمُ لِلنَّارِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ رُكْنًا مِنْ أَرْكَانِهَا ، وَإِنَّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لَمَنْ يَشْفَعُ لِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ رَبِيعَةَ ، وَمُضَرَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Hammad b. Salama, from Dawud, from 'Abd Allah b. Qays, that al-Harith b. Uqaysh narrated to Abu Barza that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: "Among my community is one who will become so large for the Fire that he will be a pillar among its pillars; and among my community is one who will intercede for more than (the tribes of) Rabi'a and Mudar."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي زُمْرَةٌ هُمْ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا ، تُضِيءُ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِضَاءَةَ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ» . فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ الْأَسَدِيُّ يَرْفَعُ نَمِرَةً عَلَيْهِ ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ؟ فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ» ، ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ؟ فَقَالَ: «سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri; Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab informed me that Abu Hurayra said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "A group of my community will enter Paradise, seventy thousand of them, their faces shining like the shining of the moon on the night of the full moon." Abu Hurayra said: 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan al-Asadi stood up, lifting up a striped cloak he was wearing, and said:
entries.matn_en: "O Messenger of God, pray to God that He make me among them." He said: "O God, make him among them." Then a man from the Ansar stood up and said: "O Messenger of God, pray to God that He make me among them." He said: "'Ukkasha has beaten you to it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ رِشْدِينَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مَالِكٍ الْجَنْبِيُّ ، أَنَّ فَضَالَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ ، وَعُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرَغَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَضَاءِ الْخَلْقِ ، فَيَبْقَى رَجُلَانِ يُؤْمَرُ بِهِمَا إِلَى النَّارِ فِيَلْتَفِتُ أَحَدُهُمَا ، فَيَقُولُ الْجبَّارُ: رُدُّوهُ ، فَيُرَدُّ ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ: لِمَ الْتَفَتَّ؟ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَرْجُو أَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي الْجَنَّةَ ، قَالَ: فِيُؤْمَرُ بِهِ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ ، قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: هَذَا عَطَاءُ رَبِّي حَتَّى إِنِّي لَوْ أَطْعَمْتُ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا عِنْدِي شَيْئًا» ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ يُرَى السُّرُورُ فِي وَجْهِهِ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Hibban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Rishdin b. Sa'd; Abu Hani' al-Khawlani informed me; 'Amr b. Malik al-Janbi informed me that Fadala b. 'Ubayd and 'Ubada b. al-Samit narrated to him that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "On the Day of Resurrection, when God has finished judging creation, two men will remain who are commanded to be taken to the Fire. One of them will turn around, and the Compeller (al-Jabbar) will say: 'Bring him back.' So he will be brought back, and it will be said to him: 'Why did you turn around?' He will say: 'I was hoping that You would admit me to Paradise.' He (the Prophet) said: Then he will be commanded to go to Paradise. He (God) will say: 'This is a gift from my Lord; even if I fed all the people of Paradise, it would not diminish what I have at all.'" Whenever the Messenger of God ﷺ mentioned it, joy could be seen on his face.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حِبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ رِشْدِينَ ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ نُعْمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
