entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه فَكَانَ إِذَا شَهِدَ مَشْهَدًا أَوْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى أَكَمَةٍ أَوْ هَبَطَ وَادِيًا ، قَالَ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، فَقُلْتُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي يَشْكُرَ: انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَتَّى نَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، فَانْطَلَقْنَا إِلَيْهِ ، فَقُلْنَا: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ، رَأَيْنَاكَ إِذَا شَهِدْتَ مَشْهَدًا أَوْ أَشْرَفْتَ عَلَى أَكَمَةٍ قُلْتَ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، فَهَلْ عَهِدَ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فِي ذَلِكَ؟ فَأَعْرَضَ عنَّا ، وَأَلحَحْنَا عَلَيْهِ ، فَقَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا شَيْئًا عَهِدَهُ إِلَى النَّاسِ ، وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ وَثَبُوا عَلَى عُثْمَانَ فَقَتَلُوهُ ، وَكَانَ غَيْرِي فِيهِ أَسْوَأَ حَالًا وَأَسْوَأُ فِعْلًا مِنِّي ، ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ أَنِّي أَحَقُّهُمْ بِهَا فَوَثَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا ، فَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ أَخْطَأْنَا أَوْ أَصَبْنَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Ma'mar informed us, from 'Ali b. Zayd b. Jud'an, from al-Hasan, from Qays b. 'Ubad, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with 'Ali (ؓ), and whenever he attended a battle scene, or looked out from a hillock, or descended into a valley, he would say: "God and His Messenger have spoken truly." I said to a man of the Banu Yashkur: "Let us go to the Commander of the Faithful and ask him about his saying: 'God and His Messenger have spoken truly.'" So we went to him and said: "O Commander of the Faithful, we have seen that when you attend a battle scene or look out from a hillock you say: 'God and His Messenger have spoken truly.' Did the Messenger of God ﷺ make some covenant with you about that?" He turned away from us, but we pressed him, and he said: "By God, the Messenger of God ﷺ made no covenant with me except something he made with all the people. But the people pounced on 'Uthman and killed him, and others than I were in a worse condition and worse in action concerning it than I was. Then I saw that I was the most deserving of them for it (the caliphate), so I leapt upon it. God knows best whether we erred or were right."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، نَا مِسْعَرٌ ، عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ مَوْلَى ثَعْلَبَةَ ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ مَنْ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ: أَمَا إِنَّكَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ «رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ شَتْمِ الْهَلْكَى ، فَلِمَ تَسُبُّ عَلِيًّا وَقَدْ مَاتَ ؟»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Mis'ar narrated to us, from al-Hajjaj, the freedman of Tha'laba, from Qutba b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Mughira b. Shu'ba said: "Who is 'Ali b. Abi Talib?" Zayd b. Arqam said to him: "Surely you know that the Messenger of God ﷺ used to forbid reviling the dead; so why do you revile 'Ali, when he has died?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أنبأ عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: وُضِعَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ، عَلَى سَرِيرِهِ فَتَكَنَّفَهُ النَّاسُ يَدْعُونَ وَيُصَلُّونَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ وَأَنَا فِيهِمْ ، فَلَمْ يَرُعْنِي إِلَّا رَجُلٌ قَدْ أَخَذَ بِمَنْكِبَيْ مِنْ وَرَائِي ، فَالْتَفَتُّ ، فَإِذَا هُوَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ، فَتَرَّحَمَ عَلَى عُمَرَ ، وَقَالَ: مَا خَلَّفْتُ أَحَدًا أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَلْقَى اللَّهَ بِمِثْلِ عَمَلِهِ مِنْكَ ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَظُنُّ لَيَجْعَلُكَ اللَّهُ مَعَ صَاحِبَيْكَ ، وذَاكَ أَنِّي كُنْتُ أُكْثِرُ أَنْ أَسْمَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «ذَهَبْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ ، وَدَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ ، وَخَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ ، فَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَظُنُّ لَيَجْعَلُكَ اللَّهُ مَعَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; 'Umar b. Abi Husayn informed us, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, that he heard Ibn 'Abbas say: 'Umar b. al-Khattab was laid on his bier, and the people gathered around him, supplicating and praying (for him) before he was lifted up, and I was among them. I was startled only by a man who took hold of my shoulders from behind. I turned, and it was 'Ali b. Abi Talib. He invoked God's mercy on 'Umar and said:
entries.matn_en: "You have left behind no one whose like of deeds I would more love to meet God with than yours; and by God, I used to think that God would place you with your two companions. That is because I often heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'I went, and Abu Bakr and 'Umar; I entered, and Abu Bakr and 'Umar; I went out, and Abu Bakr and 'Umar.' So I used to think that God would place you with the two of them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِجُنْدَبٍ: إِنِّي بَايَعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَلَى أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ أَهْلَ الشَّامِ ، قَالَ: لَعَلَّكَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَقُولَ: قَالَ لِي جُنْدَبٌ ، وَقَالَ لِي جُنْدَبٌ؟ فَقُلْتُ: لَا إِنَّمَا اسْتَفْتَيْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي ، قَالَ: افْتَدِ بِمَالِكَ ، فَقَالَ: لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنِّي ، فَقَالَ جُنْدَبٌ: إِنِّي كُنْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُلَامًا حَزْوَرًا ، وَإِنَّهُ حَدَّثَنِي فُلَانٌ ? أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «يَجِيءُ الْمَقْتُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُتَعِلَّقًا بِالْقَاتِلِ ، فَيَقُولُ: أَيْ رَبِّ ، قَتَلَنِي هَذَا. فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: فِيمَ قَتَلْتَهُ؟ فَيَقُولُ: فِي مُلْكِ فُلَانٍ ، فَاتَّقِ أَلَّا تَكُونَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Hammad b. Salama informed us, from Abu 'Imran al-Jawni, who narrated to him, saying:
entries.matn_en: I said to Jundab: "I have pledged allegiance to 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr to fight the people of Syria." He said: "Perhaps you want to say, 'Jundab told me this and Jundab told me that.'" I said: "No, I am only seeking your ruling for myself." He said: "Ransom yourself with your wealth." He said: "It would not be accepted from me." Jundab said: "In the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ I was a sturdy youth, and so-and-so narrated to me that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'The slain man will come on the Day of Resurrection clinging to his killer, and say: "My Lord, this one killed me." God will say: "For what did you kill him?" He will say: "In the dominion of so-and-so (i.e., in a struggle for someone's rule)." So beware lest you be that man.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا حَرَجَ إِلَّا فِي قَتْلِ الْمُسْلِمِ ، ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Abu Ja'far informed us, from Layth, from Mundhir al-Thawri, from Muhammad b. 'Ali, Ibn al-Hanafiyya, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "There is no blame (on a person) except for killing a Muslim," (he said it) three times.

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ: «لَوْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ تَابَعُونِي إِلَّا رَجُلٌ لَمْ يُسَدَّدْ سُلْطَانِي إِلَّا بِهِ مَا قَتَلْتُهُ»
entries.matn_en: And Ibn al-Hanafiyya said: "Even if all the people followed me except one man without whom my authority could not be made firm, I would not kill him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، حَدَّثَنِي هِلَالُ بْنُ خَبَّابٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ: ثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ، قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ حَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ ذَكَرَ الْفِتْنَةَ أَوْ ذُكِرَتْ عِنْدَهُ ، فَقَالَ: «إِذَا رَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ مَرَجَتْ عُهُودُهُمْ ، وَخَفَّتْ أَمَانَاتُهُمْ كَانوا هَكَذَا فَشَبَّكَ بَيْنَ أَنَامِلِهِ» ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِ ، فَقُلْتُ: فَكَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ، جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ؟ قَالَ: «الْزَمْ بَيْتَكَ ، وَأَمْلِكْ عَلَيْكَ لِسَانَكَ ، وَخُذْ مَا تَعْرِفُ ، وَذَرْ مَا تُنْكِرُ ، وَعَلَيْكَ بِأَمْرِ خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِكَ ، وَذَرْ عَنْكَ أَمْرَ الْعَامَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Yunus b. Abi Ishaq informed us; Hilal b. Khabbab narrated to me, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Ikrima, the freedman of Ibn 'Abbas, say: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As narrated to us, saying: While we were around the Prophet ﷺ, he mentioned tribulation, or it was mentioned in his presence, and he said: "When you see the people whose covenants have become corrupted and whose trusts have grown light, and they are like this," and he interlaced his fingers. I stood up to him and said: "What should I do at that time, O Prophet of God, may God make me your ransom?" He said: "Keep to your house, hold your tongue, take what you know (to be right) and leave what you reject, and attend to the affair of your own self, and leave aside the affair of the general public."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ، عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيَ الْخَيْفُ بْنُ السَّحَقِ ، حُبَيْسَ بْنَ دُلْجَةَ ، فِي أَهْلِ الشَّامِ بِالرَّبَذَةِ ، فَقَاتَلَهُمْ فَهَزَمَهُمْ ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَلَقِيَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ، فَقَالَ: يَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ ، مَا يُبْطِئُ بكَ عَنِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، أَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَخَاكَ قَدِيمًا ، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ أَبْطَئُوا عَنْهُ لِإِبْطَائِكَ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي قِفِّهِ ، وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا قِفُّهُ؟ قَالَ: لَا ، قَالَ: أَلَمْ تَرَ الْمَرْأَةَ تُرْضِعُ وَلَدَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا رَوِيَ أَوْ شَبِعَ ، سَلَخَ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي فِيهِ ، قَالَتْ أُمُّهُ: قِفِّهِ ، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَأَكُونَنَّ مِثْلَ الْحَمَلِ الرَّدَاحِ ، قَالَ: وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الْحَمَلُ الرَّدَاحُ؟ قَالَ: لَا ، قَالَ: هُوَ الْبَعِيرُ يَخْلُو فَيَبْرُكُ وَلَا يَبْرَحُ مَبْرَكَهُ حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ فِيهِ ، فَإِنِّي مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ الْحَمَلِ أَلْزَمُ بَيْتِيَ حَتَّى مَا يَأْتِينِي مَنْ يَنْحَرُنِي فِيهِ ، أَوْ يَجْتَمِعُ النَّاسُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ ، فَإِنِ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَى كَثَبٍ فِي صَالِحِ جَمَاعَتِهِمْ فَإِنِ اقْتَرَفُوا لَمْ أُجَامِعْهُمْ عَلَى فُرْقَتِهِمْ ، وَلَا أَعْمَلُ عَلَى رَجُلَيْنِ بَعْدَ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ اسْتَرْعَاهُ اللَّهُ رَعِيَّةً إِلَّا سَأَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَقَامَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ أَمْ أَضَاعَهُ ، حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُسْأَلُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ أَقَامَ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ فِيهِمْ أَمْ أَضَاعَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Abu Ja'far informed us, from Harun b. Sa'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Khayf b. al-Sahaq met Hubays b. Dulja, with the people of Syria, at al-Rabadha, and fought them and defeated them; then he entered Medina and met Ibn 'Umar and said: "O Ibn 'Umar, what keeps you from supporting Ibn al-Zubayr? Was he not your brother of old? The people have held back from him because of your holding back." He said: "Ibn al-Zubayr put his hand in his qiff (as printed; the word is unclear), and do you know what a qiff is?" He said: "No." He said: "Have you not seen a woman nurse her child until, when he is satisfied or full, he pulls away and puts his hand in his mouth; his mother says: 'qiffihi.' And by God, I will be like the heavy camel (al-hamal al-radah)." He said: "Do you know what the heavy camel is?" He said: "No." He said: "It is the camel that goes off alone and kneels and does not leave its kneeling place until it is slaughtered there. I am like that camel: I will keep to my house until the one who will slaughter me there comes to me, or until the people unite upon one man. If they unite upon one near at hand for the good of their community, (well and good); if they fall into discord, I will not join them in their division, and I will not side with either of two men, after what I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'There is no man whom God has made a shepherd over a flock but God will ask him about it on the Day of Resurrection, whether he upheld God's command among them or neglected it, until a man will be asked about his own family, whether he upheld the command of God among them or neglected it.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا فِي جِنَازَةِ حُذَيْفَةَ ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ صَاحِبَ هَذَا السَّرِيرِ ، يَقُولُ: مَا بِي بَأْسٌ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، «ولَئِنِ اقْتَتَلْتُمْ لَأَدْخُلَنَّ بَيْتِي ، فَلَئِنْ دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ لَأَقُولَنَّ: أَبُوءُ بِإِثْمِي وَإِثْمِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Shu'ba informed us, from Mansur, from Rib'i b. Hirash, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard a man at the funeral of Hudhayfa say: I heard the occupant of this bier say: "I have no fear about what I heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ: 'If you fight one another I will enter my house, and if (someone) enters upon me I will say: I will bear my sin and your sin.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ أَسِيدِ بْنِ الْمُتَشَمِّسِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: غَزَوْنَا مَعَ أَبِي مُوسَى أَصْبَهَانَ ، فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ فَتَحَهَا ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ رَجَعَ ورَجَعْنَا مَعَهُ ، فَنَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلًا وَكَانَ جَارًا فِيهِ عُقَيْلٌ ، فَقَالَ: مَنْ رَجُلٌ يُنْزِلُ لِينَتَهُ؟ فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهَا فَأَنْزَلْتُهَا ، فَقَالَ: أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكُمْ حَدِيثًا كَانَ يُحَدِّثُنَاهُ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قُلْنَا: بَلَى يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ الْهَرْجَ» ، فَقُلْنَا: وَمَا الْهَرْجُ؟ قَالَ: «الْقَتْلُ» ، قُلْنَا: أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا نَقْتُلُ كُلَّ عَامٍ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ ، إِنَّا لَنَقْتُلُ فِي الْوَاحِدِ كَذَا وَكَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ مَا هُوَ بِقَتْلِكُمُ الْكُفَّارَ ، وَلَكِنْ قَتْلٌ يَكُونُ سِلْمًا مَعْشَرَ أَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ حَتَّى يَقْتُلَ الرَّجُلُ جَارَهُ ، وَابْنَ عَمِّهِ ، وَيَقْتُلَ أَخَاهُ ، وَيَقْتُلَ أَبَاهُ» ، قَالَ: فَأَبْلَسْنَا حَتَّى مَا يُبْدِي أَحَدٌ كَاحِلَهُ ، فَنَظَرَ بَعْضُنَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ ، وَقُلْنَا: كَيْفَ يَقْتُلُ الرَّجُلُ مِنَّا جَارَهُ ، وَابْنَ عَمِّهِ ، وَأَبَاهُ لِلْمَوَدَّةِ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ ، وَعَلِمْنَا أَنَّ صَاحِبَنَا لَمْ يَعُدْ بِنَا ، فَقُلْنَا: أَرَأَيْتَ عُقُولَنَا الْيَوْمَ ، أَهِيَ مَعَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ؟ قَالَ: «لَا وَاللَّهِ لَيَنْزِغُ عُقُولًا كَأَهْلِ ذَلِكَ الزَّمَانِ وَكُلِّفَ لَهُ هُنَا مِنَ النَّاسِ ، نَحْسَبُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى شَيْءٍ ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ ، لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يُدْرِكَنِي وَإِيَّاكُمْ ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ ، لَئِنْ أَدْرَكَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ لِي وَلَكُمْ مِنْهَا مَخْرَجًا فِيمَا عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا أَنْ نَخْرُجَ مِنْهَا كَمَا دَخَلْنَاهَا» . قَالَ: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: أَيْ سَالِمِينَ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Mubarak b. Fadala informed us, from al-Hasan, from Usayd b. al-Mutashammis b. Mu'awiya, who said:
entries.matn_en: We campaigned with Abu Musa at Isbahan, and it was not long before he conquered it; then it was not long before he returned, and we returned with him. We stopped at a halting place, and 'Uqayl was a neighbor there. He said: "Who is the man who will unload his lina (as printed)?" So I stood up and unloaded it. He said: "Shall I not narrate to you a hadith that Muhammad ﷺ used to narrate to us?" We said: "Yes, may God have mercy on you." He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ narrated to us: "Before the Hour there will be al-harj." We said: "What is al-harj?" He said: "Killing." We said: "More than we kill each year of the disbelievers? We kill in (a single battle) so-and-so many." He said: "By God, it is not your killing of disbelievers; rather, it will be killing amongst you, in a time of peace, O company of the people of Islam, until a man kills his neighbor, and his cousin, and kills his brother, and kills his father." He said: We were stunned into silence, so that no one moved. We looked at one another and said: "How could a man among us kill his neighbor, his cousin or his father, given the affection that God has put in our hearts today?" And we knew that our companion would not exceed the truth with us (as printed; the wording is unclear). We said: "Do you think our minds will be with us on that day?" He said: "No, by God; minds will be taken away from the people of that time, and... (the text here is unclear in the source)... of the people; we think that most of them are upon something while they are not upon anything. By God, I fear that it will reach me and you; and by God, if it reaches me I know of no way out for myself and for you, according to what the Prophet ﷺ entrusted to us, except that we leave it as we entered it." Al-Hasan said: "That is, safe (unscathed)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Malik informed us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Sa'sa'a, from his father, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "A time is coming when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep, which he follows to the mountain peaks and the places where rain falls, fleeing with his religion from tribulations."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ وَابِصَةَ الْأَسَدِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَبِالْكُوفَةِ فِي دَارِي إِذْ سَمِعْتُ عَلَى بَابِ الدَّارِ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ ، فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ ، فَلَجَّ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ إِذَا هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، أَيُّ سَاعَةِ زِيَارَةٍ هَذِهِ ، وذَلِكَ فِي بَحْرِ الظَّهِيرَةِ؟ قَالَ: طَالَ عَلَيَّ النَّهَارُ فَذَكَرْتُ مَنْ أَتَحَدَّثُ إِلَيْهِ ، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ يُحَدِّثُنِي عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُحَدِّثُهُ ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُنِي ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ «تَكُونُ فِتْنَةٌ ، النَّائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمُضْطَجِعِ ، وَالْمُضْطَجِعُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَاعِدِ ، وَالْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ ، وَالْقَائِمُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي ، وَالْمَاشِي خَيْرٌ مِنَ الرَّاكِبِ ، وَالرَّاكِبُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْجَارِي ، قَتْلَاهَا كُلُّهَا فِي النَّارِ» ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، وَمَتَى ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ: «ذَاكَ الْهَرْجُ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: وَمَتَى أَيَّامُ الْهَرْجِ؟ قَالَ: «حِينَ لَا يَأْمَنُ الرَّجُلُ جَلِيسَهُ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَبِمَ تَأْمُرُنِي إِذَا أَدْرَكْتُ ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ: «اكْفُفْ نَفْسَكَ وَيَدَيْكَ وَادْخُلْ دَارَكَ» ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ دَارِي؟ قَالَ: «فَادْخُلْ بَيْتَكَ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ بَيْتِي؟ قَالَ: «فَادْخُلْ مَسْجِدَكَ ، ثُمَّ اصْنَعْ هَكَذَا ، ثُمَّ قَبَضَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى الْكُوعِ ، وقُلْ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ حَتَّى تُقْتَلَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Ma'mar informed us, from Salim, from Ishaq b. Rashid, from 'Amr b. Wabisa al-Asadi, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was in Kufa in my house when I heard at the door of the house: "Peace be upon you." I said: "And upon you be peace." He came in persistently, and when he entered, it was 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud. I said: "O Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, what time of day is this for a visit?" and that was in the depth of the noon heat. He said: "The day grew long for me, so I thought of someone to talk with." He said: He began to narrate to me from the Messenger of God ﷺ, and I narrated to him; then he began to relate to me, saying: I heard him say: "There will be a tribulation in which the sleeper is better than the one lying down, the one lying down is better than the one sitting, the one sitting is better than the one standing, the one standing is better than the one walking, the one walking is better than the one riding, and the one riding is better than the one running. Those slain in it are all in the Fire." I said: "O Messenger of God, and when will that be?" He said: "That will be the harj (killing)." I said: "And when are the days of harj?" He said: "When a man is not safe from his own companion." I said: "Then what do you command me to do if I live to see it?" He said: "Restrain yourself and your hands, and enter your house." I said: "O Messenger of God, what if someone enters upon me in my house?" He said: "Then enter your room." I said: "And what if someone enters upon me in my room?" He said: "Then enter your place of prayer, then do like this," then he gripped his right hand around his wrist, "and say: 'My Lord is God,' until you are killed in that (state)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَخْبرَهُ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَحْيَى ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «فِي الْفِتْنَةِ لَا تَرَوْنَ الْقَتْلَ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Yahya b. Sa'id informed me, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, that a man informed him, from his father Yahya, that he was with Ibn 'Umar, and Ibn 'Umar said to him:
entries.matn_en: "In tribulation, you do not regard killing as anything."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ وَاحِدٍ»
entries.matn_en: And the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Two shall not converse privately to the exclusion of one."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَيشًا وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَجُلًا فَأَوْقَدَ نَارًا ، فَقَالَ: ادْخُلُوهَا ، فَأَرَادَ نَاسٌ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوهَا ، وَقَالَ آخَرُونَ: إِنَّمَا فَرَرْنَا مِنْهَا ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ لِلَّذِينَ أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَدْخُلُوهَا: «لَوْ دَخَلْتُمُوهَا لَمْ تَزَالُوا فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ أَبَدًا» ، وَقَالَ لِلَآخَرِينَ قَوْلًا حَسَنًا ، وَقَالَ: «أَحْسَنْتُمْ ، لَا طَاعَةَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّمَا الطَّاعَةُ فِي الْمَعْرُوفِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Shu'ba informed us, from Zubayd, from Sa'd b. 'Ubayda, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, from 'Ali (ﷺ), who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent out an army and appointed a man as commander over them. He kindled a fire and said: "Enter it." Some people wanted to enter it, while others said: "We fled from it (by accepting Islam)." That was mentioned to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he said to those who had wanted to enter it: "Had you entered it, you would have remained in it until the Day of Resurrection, forever." And he spoke kindly to the others and said: "You did well; there is no obedience to anyone in disobedience to God; obedience is only in what is right."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، نَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «سَتَكُونُ أُمَرَاءُ يَغْشَاهُمْ غَوَاشٍ، أَوْ حَوَاشٍ، مِنَ النَّاسِ يَظْلِمُونَ ويَكْذِبُونَ ، فَمَنْ أَعَانَهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ وَصَدَّقَهُمْ بَكَذِبِهِمْ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي وَلَا أَنَا مِنْهُ ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَدِّقْهُمْ بَكَذِبِهِمْ وَيُعِينُهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ ، فَأَنَا مِنْهُ وَهُوَ مِنِّي»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Shu'ba narrated to us, from Qatada, from Sulayman b. Abi Sulayman, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: "There will be rulers who will be surrounded by crowds (or hangers-on) of people; they will wrong and lie. Whoever helps them in their wrongdoing and believes them in their lies is not of me and I am not of him. And whoever does not believe them in their lies and does not help them in their wrongdoing, I am of him and he is of me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، نَا عَوْفٌ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَرِضَ مَعْقِلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ ، فَلَمَّا ثَقُلَ عَادَهُ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ فِي بَيْتِهِ ، فَلَمَّا جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ مَعْقِلٌ: إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنِ اسْتُرْعِيَ رَعِيَّةً فَلَمْ يُحِطْهَا بِنَصِيحَةٍ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ رِيحَ الْجَنَّةِ ، وَرِيحُهَا يُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ مِائَةِ عَامٍ» ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ: أَلَا كُنْتَ حَدَّثْتَنِي هَذَا قَبْلَ الْيَوْمِ ، قَالَ: وَالْيَومُ لَوْلَا حَالَتِي الَّتِي أَنَا عَلَيْهَا لَمْ أُحَدِّثْكَ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; 'Awf narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ma'qil b. Yasar fell ill with the illness in which he died. When it became severe, Ibn Ziyad visited him in his house. When he sat with him, Ma'qil said: "I am going to narrate to you a hadith I heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Whoever is made shepherd over a flock and does not surround them with sincere counsel, God has forbidden him the scent of Paradise, though its scent can be found from a journey of a hundred years.'" Ibn Ziyad said: "Why did you not narrate this to me before today?" He said: "Today, were it not for the state I am in, I would not have narrated it to you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْعَوْفِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَقْرَبُهُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا ، إِمَامٌ عَادِلٌ ، وَأَبْغَضُ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَشَدُّهُمْ عَذَابًا ، إِمَامٌ جَائِرٌ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; al-Fudayl b. Marzuq informed us, from 'Atiyya al-'Awfi, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The most beloved of people to God on the Day of Resurrection, and the nearest of them to me in seat, is a just ruler; and the most hated of people to God on the Day of Resurrection, and the most severe of them in punishment, is a tyrannical ruler."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّكُمْ سَتَحْرِصُونَ عَلَى الْإِمَارَةِ ، وَإِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ نَدَامَةً وحَسْرَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ، فَنِعْمَتِ الْمُرْضِعَةُ ، وَبِئْسَتِ الْفَاطِمَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "You will be eager for leadership, and it will be a cause of regret and remorse on the Day of Resurrection. How excellent the wet-nurse, and how wretched the weaner."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا جَهْمُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ، ومَرَّ بِهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رُسْتُمَ فِي مَرْكِبِهِ ، فَقَالَ لِابْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ: إِنِّي لَأَشْتَهِي مَجَالِسَكَ وَحَدِيثَكَ ، فَلَمَّا مَضَى ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا تَغْبِطَنَّ فَاجِرًا بِنِعْمَةٍ ، فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا هُوَ لَاقٍ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ ، إِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَاتِلًا لَا يَمُوتُ» ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ وَهْبَ بْنَ مُنَبِّهٍ ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ وَهْبٌ أَبَا دَاوُدَ الْأَعْوَرَ ، فَقَالَ: يَا فُلَانُ ، مَا قَاتِلًا لَا يَمُوتُ؟ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ: النَّارُ
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Jahm b. Aws informed us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. Abi Maryam, when 'Abd Allah b. Rustam passed by him on his mount and said to Ibn Abi Maryam: "I long for your assemblies and your conversation." When he had gone, Ibn Abi Maryam said: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Do not envy a wicked person for a blessing, for you do not know what he will meet after his death; he has with God a killer who does not die." That reached Wahb b. Munabbih, so Wahb sent to him Abu Dawud al-A'war, and he said: "O so-and-so, what is the killer who does not die?" Ibn Abi Maryam said: "The Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي قَابُوسَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Abu Qabus, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Show mercy to those on earth, and those in heaven will show mercy to you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ رَفَقَ بِأُمَّتِي رَفَقَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ، وَمَنْ شَقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي شَقَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; Sufyan al-Thawri informed us, from Ja'far b. Burqan, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from 'A'isha, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever is gentle with my community, God will be gentle with him; and whoever burdens my community, God will burden him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، نَا حَبَّانُ، أَنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، أَنا الزُّهْرِيُّ ، أَنا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا مِنْ وَالٍ وَلَا أَمِيرٍ إِلَّا لَهُ بِطَانَتَانِ ، بِطَانَةٌ تَأْمُرُهُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ، وَبِطَانَةٌ لَا تَأْلُوهُ خَبَالًا ، فَمَنْ وُقِيَ شَرَّهَا فَقَدْ وُقِيَ ، وَهُوَ لِلَّذِي يَغْلِبُ مِنْهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: My grandfather narrated to us; Habban narrated to us; 'Abd Allah informed us; al-Awza'i informed us; al-Zuhri informed us; Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman informed us, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "There is no governor or commander but he has two groups of confidants: a group that commands him to do right and forbids him wrong, and a group that spares no effort to corrupt him. Whoever is protected from the evil of the latter is (truly) protected; and he (the ruler) goes with whichever of the two prevails."
